notes.title: New Demo Available
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have now uploaded the new demo for you to try out. In the new sandbox maps you can explore more of the possibilities of the game. Each map has its own season. 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/dc6f545268b9ae7ae1512a4237e109f960d369af.png[/img]





[h2]Download the Demo Here[/h2]* [url=https://eatcreatesleep.itch.io/ar-shallow-waters]itch[/url]
* [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/AR-shallowwaters/456389]Gamejolt[/url]
* [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/among-ripples-shallow-waters]IndieDB[/url]
* [url=eatcreatesleep.net/demo/]Our server if you sign up to the newsletter[/url]



[h2]Unlock the Full Demo[/h2]We have added three new sandbox maps with different seasons and a new toxic trash gameplay mechanic. To play these you need to subscribe to our newsletter. Everyone who are already subscribed can download the new demo and login with your email to unlock the new demo. What the game does is simply ask Mailchimp (our newsletter provider) if you're subscribed and if Mailchimp says yes you're good to go. :)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/febd1de271d712124ba8fd55fe9242c3741163a1.png[/img]


[h2]Coming to Steam Soon[/h2]We were not able to upload the demo in time, Valve will review it for release here on Steam for a few days. We will update you when it's finally online here. But if you're really itching to try it you still have four other ways! The demo will be available on the Among Ripples: Shallow Waters page soon.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096090/Among_Ripples_Shallow_Waters



---

Happy Holidays from the Eat Create Sleep team!

notes.title: Latest Update on Among Ripples 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here's some news about the game. We're still in talks with several publishers and hope to sign something soon, this would bring a lot of stability the team has never seen before and we can develop the game in (relative) peace and quiet.


We did a mockup for the interface, it's a bit crowded, it will change a lot.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/mS198AQ.png[/img]



The base game would take place in Sweden but we wan't to add more campaigns set in other parts of the world. Here's new concept art for the Hebrides in Scotland.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8x6Klbn.jpg[/img]


Previously we also did concept art for the Red Sea and China.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/JGwfiKl.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tJMUYTI.png[/img]


We have begun early development on the proper game, so all of the actual content looks very unfinished. Within 8-10 months we hope to be at the same level as the prototype. Usually you build prototypes with duct tape and glue and it's not something you want to build a complete game on, so you basically start from scratch and use what you've learned.

Lastly I want to show you the life of pikes. the team added a first person camera to the animals before we wrapped up development on the prototype, you can't control it, but it looks very interesting imo!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iJrjSR9.gif[/img]

We will be posting more of these on our social media, won't spam you here. And currently we have a [url=https://twitter.com/AmongRipples/status/1116615729816588288]poll on Twitter[/url] for which animal to do next.


The best place to follow development and interact with us right now is Discord, feel free to join.

https://discordapp.com/invite/ecs



Stay tuned for more!
//Martin & ECS

notes.title: 3 Year Anniversary - Soundtrack Now Available for Free!
notes.content:
Wow! 3 years and people are still playing Among Ripples & uploading videos about it! Thank you very much for playing this little experiment we did years ago when we were still students.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/t6JN2X3.jpg[/img]


To show you our appreciation for all your support, we decided to give you a little present. If you navigate to your Steam Library folder of Among Ripples, you'll find that we added the beloved background song for you to listen to whenever you want. If it's not there, please activate automatic updates for Among Ripples or restart Steam.

Among Ripples has now also a [url=http://twitter.com/amongripples]Twitter account[/url]. Keep an eye out for any upcoming announcements in the near future... ;)

In the past years, our little team has grown to the respectable size of 10 and we're close to finishing our second game, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/341710/Crest__an_indirect_god_sim/]Crest - an indirect god sim[/url]. If you like deep sims with easy controls, it should be right up your alley. 

To stay updated with everything we're doing:
[list]
[*]Follow us on [url=http://facebook.com/eatcreatesleep]Facebook[/url] & [url=http://twitter.com/eatcreatesleep]Twitter[/url]
[*]Have a chat with us on [url=http://discord.gg/ecs]Discord[/url] 
[*]Sign up for our, major announcements only, [url=http://eatcreatesleep.us11.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=1a5eccc1a56aab7580ddd0e5a&id=fa6da55a32]Newsletter[/url] [/list]

Happy Birthday to all of you,
Eat Create Sleep

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jO8JnSG8fpo

notes.title: Game Update and Promotion
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/BPRQcEB.png[/img]



Hello all!

We've been busy with developing [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/341710]Crest - an indirect god sim[/url], which has been out on Steam now in Early Access for two months. We think you would find Crest appealing since it's also a management game with indirect control. 

We'd really appreciate it if you'd support us,  [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/341710]wishlist Crest now[/url]. 

We've also updated Among Ripples to the new version of the Unity engine. Among Ripples is now running on Unity 5. We don't promise that this will solve any possible problems you've had, but the engine is more optimised than ever. We've also added the option to turn the sound off, as many of you have asked us to do. Lastly, we've implemented an ad in the menu that links to Crest. We've got to eat too you know. 

The ad is not displayed anywhere outside of the menu. This is how the menu looks like now.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5MzfzqX.png[/img]

We hope you will keep in touch with us as we're continuing developing new experiences, you can see more of what we're up to on these platforms:

[url=http://discord.gg/ecs]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/EatCreateSleep]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/eatcreatesleep]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/user/eatcreatesleep]Youtube[/url]

Thank you for your continued support and praise for Among Ripples. We really appreciate it!
